_: Textes de l'interface du quiz. page : les marqueurs {{clé}} de template.html, tels qu'ils s'écrivent à cet endroit du gabarit (contenu d'une chaîne JavaScript ou texte HTML). build : ce que build.py affiche ou écrit lui-même. themes : description des thèmes livrés dans l'aperçu, quand elle diffère de celle du thème.

page.tu_relis_les_reponses_d_une: You're reviewing a team's answers to a decision quiz. The quiz owner answered every question: that's the chosen answer. Participants gave their feedback, often with a note.
page.repere_les_nuances_et_les_reponses: Spot the participants' notes and free answers that contradict the chosen answer: they actually argue for another choice, set a condition incompatible with it, or reject it. A detail, an addition, a light reservation or an agreement aren't contradictions. When in doubt, flag nothing.

page.ne_garde_que_les_textes_ci: Keep only the texts below (notes, free answers, “anything else”) that suggest or ask for something with a feasibility stake: extra work, a risk, a dependency. A detail, an agreement or a preference with no consequence don't count. When in doubt, keep nothing.

When the background says what it brings, set the cost against the gain, without concluding for anyone.

themes.ardoise: The original theme: dark monochrome slate, a single green accent for the interface, stamps in Anton. Dark only.
themes.cobalt: A deep cobalt blue background, a chartreuse accent that pops on it, soft corners. Dark first, with a pale blue light mode.
themes.homie: The glass bubble of the Homie suite: a periwinkle sky fading to bluish white, milky glass panels with white edges, rounded everywhere, Fredoka and Figtree, two shapes drifting in the back and the Homie orb. Light first, with the suite's night mode.
themes.papier: Paper grey and the blue-green ink of a fountain pen, discreet corners, room between questions: made for reading at length. Light first, with a carbon-paper dark mode.
themes.signal: Crisp white, solid black and safety orange, sharp corners and a tight layout: for short quizzes you get through fast. Light first, with a black dark mode.
